about_the_game:
After colliding with a meteor cloud, the Odyssey-7 loses contact with Earth. The system is damaged, there are no signals, and the crew is dead. Only two remain: navigation officer Anna Kowalski and ship commander Ryan Hale.
In the silence of space, where every breath is an effort, something more than the mere instinct to survive is born between them.

Anna searches for a way to repair the antenna and save the mission. When she goes down to the captain's quarters, she finds Ryan having already given up hope of rescue.
One glance, one movement, and the cold metal turns into the warmth of a human body.
In zero gravity, there is nothing to lean on but each other.

Now, they must decide whether to fight for their lives or simply allow themselves to live, at least once, here in the abyss where no one will hear them breathe.

Game features:
• An atmosphere of isolation and cosmic silence where passion is the last source of warmth.
• The story of two survivors balancing between hope, fear, and desire.
• Detailed visual scenes of the ship, stars, weightlessness, and light from pulsating panels.
• Dialogues that reveal the characters' personalities and inner conflicts.
• Erotic scenes built on tension and emotional intimacy.
• Musical accompaniment and cinematic presentation create the feeling of real space.
